mythic.name: The Prince of Thieves
mythic.lore: Steals from the vault, gives to the mob.

mythic.name: The Gentleman
mythic.lore: He left a thank you note where the diamonds used to be.

mythic.name: The Vanisher
mythic.lore: Jumped with the bag and was never seen again.

mythic.name: The Outlaw
mythic.lore: Dead or alive, the reward keeps going up.

mythic.name: The Ironclad
mythic.lore: Bullets bounce, the vault does not.

mythic.name: The Mastermind
mythic.lore: He already left with it before you noticed.

mythic.name: The Cat
mythic.lore: Nine lives, one diamond at a time.

mythic.name: Public Enemy
mythic.lore: The feds have a file, and it is very thick.

mythic.name: The Professor
mythic.lore: The whole city is watching, and he planned on that.

mythic.name: The Lovers
mythic.lore: They robbed together, and they ran together.
